reviewAdvisory: The draft asserts a 'new format' for certificates of origin that no supplied figure or source establishes, and the article elsewhere admits the report does not state which documents are affected.

The draft asserts documentation will work across the region, a specific outcome the cited report does not state and the article's own confidence section calls an inference.
The draft declares a saving 'real' when no figure or source in the evidence quantifies or establishes it, contradicting the article's own 'directional, not priced' framing.
The confidence section admits smoother origin and customs procedures is an inference, yet the AI Summary and description state it as a directive fact, so the confidence section contradicts the body.
